title: GTA 6 One Week Later: Exploring Leonida This Weekend
description: As GTA 6 hits its one-week anniversary, gaming media Push Square discusses diving into Leonida to escape the miserable winter weather.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Escaping to Leonida as Winter Approaches

We're hurtling towards Christmas now, and the miserable weather outside is evidence enough of the changing season. Fortunately, for gamers looking for a warm escape from the winter chill, there's always Leonida to explore. As Grand Theft Auto VI hits its one-week anniversary, players and gaming outlets alike are reflecting on their early days in Rockstar's latest virtual world.

In the latest installment of Push Square's weekend gaming discussion (Issue 660), the topic naturally centers on how everyone is getting on with GTA 6 now that it has been out in the wild for a full week.

## Thirty-Five Hours and Counting

Sharing his experience with the game, Push Square editor Aaron Bayne noted that he is about 35 hours into the game at this point. After spending a solid week exploring the map, he expressed that he is simply in awe of what Rockstar Games has conjured up with this release.

Whether players are pacing themselves through the narrative or getting completely distracted by the sheer density of the open world, the conversation surrounding the game remains exceptionally lively as the first post-launch weekend arrives.

## Editor's Take

Escaping the miserable weather by diving into the sunny, detailed world of Leonida sounds like the ultimate weekend plan. With around 35 hours already logged by some critics, it's clear that Rockstar has crafted an experience that continues to captivate long after the initial launch hype settles.
